```{r figure-5}
# Combined virus-host relationship analysis

required_packages <- c(
  "readxl",
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "igraph",
  "tidygraph",
  "ggraph",
  "ggrepel",
  "ComplexHeatmap",
  "circlize",
  "RColorBrewer"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Missing R packages: ",
      paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
      "\nInstall them before running this script."
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(igraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)
library(ggrepel)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)


input_file <- "virus_host.xlsx"
output_dir <- "figure5_results"

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop(
    paste0("Input file not found: ", input_file),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

df <- read_excel(input_file)
colnames(df) <- trimws(colnames(df))

required_columns <- c(
  "qseqid",
  "pident",
  "qcovhsp",
  "Virus family",
  "Virus genus",
  "Host class",
  "Host order",
  "Host family",
  "Host genus",
  "Host Species"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, colnames(df))

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Missing required columns in ",
      input_file,
      ": ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}


network_data <- df %>%
  select(
    qseqid,
    `Virus genus`,
    `Host Species`,
    `Host order`
  ) %>%
  rename(
    virus = `Virus genus`,
    host = `Host Species`,
    order = `Host order`
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(virus),
    virus != "",
    !is.na(host),
    host != "",
    !is.na(order),
    order != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(qseqid, virus, host, order)

network_edges_virus_host <- network_data %>%
  count(virus, host, name = "weight") %>%
  rename(
    from = virus,
    to = host
  )

network_edges_host_order <- network_data %>%
  distinct(host, order) %>%
  rename(
    from = host,
    to = order
  ) %>%
  mutate(weight = 1)

network_edges <- bind_rows(
  network_edges_virus_host,
  network_edges_host_order
)

network_virus_nodes <- network_data %>%
  count(virus) %>%
  transmute(
    name = virus,
    type = "Virus",
    size = n
  )

network_host_nodes <- network_data %>%
  count(host) %>%
  transmute(
    name = host,
    type = "Host",
    size = n
  )

network_order_nodes <- network_data %>%
  distinct(order) %>%
  transmute(
    name = order,
    type = "Order",
    size = 18
  )

network_nodes <- bind_rows(
  network_virus_nodes,
  network_host_nodes,
  network_order_nodes
)

network_nodes$type[network_nodes$name == "Homo sapiens"] <- "Human"

network_graph <- graph_from_data_frame(
  network_edges,
  vertices = network_nodes,
  directed = FALSE
)

network_tbl <- as_tbl_graph(network_graph) %>%
  mutate(deg = centrality_degree())

p_host_order <- ggraph(network_tbl, layout = "stress") +
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(width = weight),
    colour = "grey75",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_node_point(
    aes(
      color = type,
      size = size
    ),
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = name),
    repel = TRUE,
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 200
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      Virus = "#D55E00",
      Host = "#0072B2",
      Order = "#009E73",
      Human = "#CC79A7"
    )
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(3, 16)) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(
    title = "Virus-Host-Order Association Network",
    subtitle = "Urban bird fecal virome"
  )

print(p_host_order)

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "virus_host_order_network.pdf"),
  p_host_order,
  width = 14,
  height = 12
)

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "virus_host_order_network.png"),
  p_host_order,
  width = 14,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 600
)

write.table(
  network_edges,
  file.path(output_dir, "virus_host_order_network_edges.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  network_nodes,
  file.path(output_dir, "virus_host_order_network_nodes.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)


heatmap_data <- df %>%
  select(
    qseqid,
    `Virus family`,
    `Virus genus`,
    `Host class`,
    `Host order`,
    `Host family`,
    `Host genus`,
    `Host Species`
  ) %>%
  rename(
    vfamily = `Virus family`,
    vgenus = `Virus genus`,
    class = `Host class`,
    order = `Host order`,
    family = `Host family`,
    genus = `Host genus`,
    species = `Host Species`
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(vgenus),
    vgenus != "",
    !is.na(class),
    class != "",
    !is.na(species),
    species != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    qseqid,
    vfamily,
    vgenus,
    class,
    order,
    family,
    genus,
    species
  )

heatmap_presence <- heatmap_data %>%
  distinct(species, vgenus) %>%
  mutate(value = 1L)

heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_presence %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = vgenus,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = 0L
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- heatmap_matrix$species
heatmap_matrix$species <- NULL
heatmap_matrix <- as.matrix(heatmap_matrix)

host_taxonomy <- heatmap_data %>%
  distinct(
    species,
    class,
    order,
    family,
    genus
  )

host_taxonomy <- host_taxonomy[
  match(rownames(heatmap_matrix), host_taxonomy$species),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

virus_taxonomy <- heatmap_data %>%
  distinct(vgenus, vfamily)

virus_taxonomy <- virus_taxonomy[
  match(colnames(heatmap_matrix), virus_taxonomy$vgenus),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

heatmap_row_order <- order(
  host_taxonomy$class,
  host_taxonomy$order,
  host_taxonomy$family,
  host_taxonomy$genus,
  host_taxonomy$species
)

heatmap_col_order <- order(
  virus_taxonomy$vfamily,
  virus_taxonomy$vgenus
)

heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[
  heatmap_row_order,
  heatmap_col_order,
  drop = FALSE
]

host_taxonomy <- host_taxonomy[
  heatmap_row_order,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

virus_taxonomy <- virus_taxonomy[
  heatmap_col_order,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

host_classes <- unique(host_taxonomy$class)
host_palette <- brewer.pal(12, "Set3")

host_colors <- structure(
  rep(host_palette, length.out = length(host_classes)),
  names = host_classes
)

virus_families <- unique(virus_taxonomy$vfamily)
virus_palette <- brewer.pal(9, "Pastel1")

virus_colors <- structure(
  rep(virus_palette, length.out = length(virus_families)),
  names = virus_families
)

row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  Class = host_taxonomy$class,
  col = list(Class = host_colors)
)

col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Family = virus_taxonomy$vfamily,
  col = list(Family = virus_colors)
)

heat_colors <- c(
  "0" = "white",
  "1" = "#87CEEB"
)

ht <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  name = "Virus detected",
  col = heat_colors,
  left_annotation = row_anno,
  top_annotation = col_anno,
  row_split = host_taxonomy$class,
  column_split = virus_taxonomy$vfamily,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 6),
  column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7),
  column_names_rot = 90
)

pdf(
  file.path(output_dir, "virus_host_heatmap.pdf"),
  width = 12,
  height = 14
)
draw(ht)
dev.off()

png(
  file.path(output_dir, "virus_host_heatmap.png"),
  width = 3000,
  height = 3500,
  res = 400
)
draw(ht)
dev.off()

write.table(
  heatmap_matrix,
  file.path(output_dir, "virus_host_heatmap_matrix.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  col.names = NA
)


```
